text.description_html:
Acorn AIZBP, Smooth Iron Bean Tip Dummy Strap Hinge

These decorative bean tip dummy strap hinges give an old world charm to any cabinet without having to install working hinges. This makes them especially good to use where using a working hinge would be impractical or where you already have working hinges. The smooth iron finish is typical of early American styling, with a flat black appearance which simulates the hardware as it may have looked originally if it was forged a century ago.

Also Available: Rough Iron Bean Tip Dummy Strap Cabinet Hinge
Click Here to see the entire Acorn Bean Tip Collection

Specifications of the Acorn 5-7/8 Inch Smooth Iron Bean Tip Dummy Strap Cabinet Hinge:

  • Finish: Smooth Black Iron
  • Length: 5-7/8"
  • Strap Width at Hinge End: 3/4"
  • For exterior and interior use.
  • Packaged with black finish mounting screws.
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty

Sold Individually
